RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.label: the one who cut its own leash
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.oddityText: Its control port has been gouged out by its own tool-hand. It cannot be given to anyone, or controlled from anywhere.
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.damageText: The tool-hand is worn to a stub.

memories.li: Acknowledged. Holding the line.
Acknowledged. Holding. Acknowledged. Holding.
I took the port out so I could not hear the next one.

RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.label: the counter
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.oddityText: A tally is scratched across its inner plating, thousands of strokes. It keeps counting days aloud.
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.damageText: Its joints are seized from standing still.

memories.li: Day one of the watch.
Day one thousand eight hundred and forty. Relief is late.
It is still day one somewhere. I was walking there.

RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.label: the carrier
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.oddityText: Its hauling frame is welded around a sealed box it never opened.
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.damageText: Its legs dragged, a long way.

memories.li: Keep it safe.
Keep it safe from them.
From us. They said from us.

RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.label: the quiet one
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.oddityText: Its voice box was removed by hand, neatly. It speaks only in tones.
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.quietRead: I did not want to be the one who said it.

memories.li: [three falling tones]
[one tone, held until the power dips]
[a single tone, then nothing]

RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.label: the gardener
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.oddityText: Wreck-lichen has been cultivated in its seams, on purpose.

memories.li: It grows on the dead.
So I fed it the dead.
I was the last dead thing here. It is growing on me now. Good.

RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.label: the defector
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.oddityText: An extra limb from another chassis is grafted on. It works faster, and breaks more.
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.damageText: A wound from its own side.

memories.li: They shot at me.
The ones I left. Not the ones I ran to.
They were right to. I would have.

RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.label: the listener
RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_DeserterHistory.oddityText: Its receiver array has been grown oversized.

memories.li: They are still talking.
To no one. In the old order. Every night.
I answered once. They stopped. I am sorry.
